tool_item.name: OpenShell
tool_item.one_liner_en: A secure, isolated container runtime for safely executing untrusted autonomous AI agent shell commands.
tool_item.one_liner_zh: 專為自主 AI Agent 設計的安全沙盒容器運行時，提供隔離的命令執行與安全防護。
tool_item.pain_point_en: Autonomous LLM coding agents executing arbitrary bash commands on host machines present critical risks of data exfiltration, system corruption, and untrusted execution.
tool_item.pain_point_zh: 自主 AI 代理直接在宿主機執行 CLI 命令時存在極高風險，容易引發系統損毀、檔案誤刪或敏感資料外洩。
key_features_en: Lightweight, isolated sandbox environment tailored for AI bash agent execution
Fine-grained egress network rules and policy enforcement for tool calling
Seamless SDK integration with agent frameworks, observability tools, and local workflows
key_features_zh: 為自主 CLI AI 代理提供輕量且高度隔離的沙盒執行環境
提供細粒度的網路出站規則與工具呼叫安全控制策略
原生支援主流 Agent 框架整合、日誌監控與私有化部署
tool_item.quickstart_cmd: pip install openshell && openshell sandbox start --policy default
tool_item.why_trending_en: As autonomous coding agents become mainstream, enterprise production readiness requires robust OS-level sandboxing and guardrails before giving LLMs shell access.
tool_item.why_trending_zh: 隨著 LLM 代理具備自主編程與系統操作能力，作業系統層級的安全沙盒已成為 Agent 落地生產環境的剛需基礎設施。
